label: LTS · v3.1.1
author: Codexadi25
message: feat: document v3.0.0 and v3.1.0 releases, update UI changelog, and create dedicated version-history workflow
changelog: **4-Tier Realtime Presence System** — Fully real-time presence lifecycle powered directly by Firebase Realtime Database (RTDB) and WebSocket connections: `Online`, `Idle` (after 3 minutes of inactivity), `On Break`, `Unresponsive` (automatic WebSocket `onDisconnect()` transition on tab/browser close), and `Offline` (on explicit logout).

**User Profile & Activity Dashboard Pop-up** — Clicking any user row in the Admin Users table opens a full-screen interactive modal with user profile details, live presence badges, session stats, and real-time activity history stream.

**Instagram-Style Infinite Scroll ('Doomscrolling')** — User activity history automatically loads older pages (25 events per batch) as the user scrolls down, complete with a clean "You're all caught up" completion state.
**Skeleton Shimmer Animation** — Custom CSS shimmer animation (`@keyframes uam-shimmer`) displaying pulsing skeleton cards during modal loading and paginated scroll requests.

**Smart Activity Categorization & Collapsible Threads** — Modular client timeline engine (`userActivityTimeline.js`) that groups repetitive background pings and heartbeats into collapsible accordion threads while isolating distinct data events, profile edits, and logins.

**Render Zero-Downtime Session Persistence** — Integrated `connect-mongo` session storage with 14-day retention and lazy updating (`touchAfter: 24h`), ensuring container rollouts and restarts on Render never log active users out.

**Zero-DB Heartbeat Architecture** — Removed high-frequency database writes on `/api/ping` and `/api/heartbeat`; active users are cached in-memory with 60s TTL to prevent MongoDB connection exhaustion.

**Admin Table Streamline** — Removed redundant Password and Actions columns from the main users table, relocating password resets, defaults, and account deletions into the dedicated user profile dashboard.
**Health Check Resilience** — Updated `/api/ping` to respond with `200 OK` for unauthenticated deployment monitors and CI/CD health checks without forcing logins.

label: LTS · v3.0.0
author: Codexadi25
message: feat: v3.0.0 — Multi-Cloud Deployment Suite, Serverless Adapters, Performance Pulse Analytics & Briefings Feed
changelog: 🚀 **Multi-Cloud Continuous Deployment** — Fully configured automated deployment blueprints for Render (`render.yaml`), Vercel (`vercel.json`), Netlify (`netlify.toml`), and self-hosted VPS environments.
🌐 **Serverless Express Architecture** — Added `serverless-http` integration and dedicated serverless handlers (`api/index.js`, `netlify/functions/server.js`) for rapid cold-starts.
📊 **Performance Pulse Analytics Suite** — Roster management, automated shift tracking, break recording, and Excel batch uploads with composite KPI scorecard calculations.
📢 **Department Briefings Feed** — Real-time team announcement board with priority badges and broadcast notifications across all departments.
🤖 **Gemini AI Integration** — Upgraded to modern `@google/genai` models with contextual response generation for customer service workflows.
🎙️ **Audio Translation & Voice Tools** — Added support for audio translation and voice canned responses for agents.

label: LTS · v2.6.0
author: Codexadi25
message: feat: v2.6.0 — Floating Chat Sidebar, Veronica AI Vector Search, Live Data Route, Token Limiting
changelog: 💬 **Floating Chat Sidebar** — Messages tab removed in favor of a sleek, floating chat sidebar anchored to the bottom right.
🤖 **Veronica AI Integration** — Powered by Gemini & MongoDB Atlas Vector Search to answer questions using context drawn directly from live SOPs.
🔄 **Smart Reply Options** — Click the reply icon on any AI or chat message to thread replies with full context.
🛡️ **AI Token Rate Limiting** — Non-admin users are restricted to generating a maximum of 1,000 words (tokens) per day to ensure stability.
⚡ **Live Data SOP Panel** — Removed legacy static data; the master SOP panel now exclusively routes through the live `/sop/:department/:lob/view` endpoints.
🧹 **Removed Legacy Modules** — The old 'Notices' widget and 'General' department constraint have been securely eradicated from the system.

label: LTS · v2.5.1
author: Codexadi25
message: fix: restore LTS CSS architecture broken by cc52980
changelog: 🔒 **Strict Username Policy & Validation** — Block special characters (except underscores) during registration, admin bulk-creation, and profile settings, enforced at Mongoose schema, controller, route, and input layers.
🛡️ **Login Security Interception** — Login attempts using usernames containing special characters are instantly caught by an interception layer displaying an explicit security warning.
🔑 **Two-Factor Admin Deletion Confirmation** — Admin-scoped deletes now prompt for exact username confirmation to prevent accidental account deletion.

⚡ **Inline Smart SOP Panel Integration** — The "Smart SOP" button now opens the SOP view/editor inline inside the dashboard tabs rather than redirecting the user to a separate browser tab, providing a more cohesive experience.
✨ Added live oninput frontend sanitization for the username input field during registration and profile settings.
